say:1:1320612001:1.text: What did you find out from your test, Ludovic?
say:1:1320612001:1.source_cn: 柳博米尔先生，你的检查结果是……

say:2:1320612002:1.text: Do not let Carolina hear of this.
say:2:1320612002:1.source_cn: 轻声，别让卡列琳娜听到。

choice_prompt:3:1320612002.text: Do not let Carolina hear of this.
choice_prompt:3:1320612002.source_cn: 轻声，别让卡列琳娜听到。

say:4:1320612003:1.text: It was indeed soul-binding magic, and it was performed hastily and roughly. The soul tethered to this vessel is on the brink of shattering.
say:4:1320612003:1.source_cn: ……的确是缚灵魔法，而且施展得粗暴匆忙，被束缚在这具躯...

say:5:1320612004:1.text: The pain of his soul is unimaginable. It's a miracle that such a broken soul could survive in such a body for so long.
say:5:1320612004:1.source_cn: 就像要用柔嫩的脚尖在刀刃上行走一般，灵魂受到的痛苦难以...

say:6:1320612005:1.text: I think he's at his limit and can no longer hold on.
say:6:1320612005:1.source_cn: 我想……他濒临极限，快坚持不下去了。

say:7:1320612006:1.text: How could this have happened? Who would do such a cruel thing?!
say:7:1320612006:1.source_cn: 怎么会这样，谁会对铐兰做出这么残忍的事情？！

say:8:1320612007:1.text: Could it be a Hypogean or one of their minions...? You said that when the Hypofiends invaded, the Radinov family stood on the front lines of battle.
say:8:1320612007:1.source_cn: 会是恶魔或是眷属吗……？你说过，魔物大举入侵的时候，拉...

say:9:1320612008:1.text: Maybe after they broke into the Radinov estate, they killed Callan and did this as revenge...
say:9:1320612008:1.source_cn: 难道它们攻破拉季诺夫庄园之后，作为报复，他们把当时还活...

say:13:1320612011:2.text: We're just guessing, Carolina. Please don't be upset...
say:13:1320612011:2.source_cn: 卡列琳娜，我们现在还只是推测，请你不要过于悲伤……

say:14:1320612012:1.text: No, thank you for informing me of the truth. For so many years, every night I've asked myself if it was enough to have my brother by my side like this.
say:14:1320612012:1.source_cn: 不，谢谢你们告知我真相。这么多年，每个夜晚我都在问自己...

say:15:1320612013:1.text: I've watched him grow more silent by the day, and I knew that he would leave me one day. I was so afraid that I would be alone again.
say:15:1320612013:1.source_cn: 我看着他一天比一天沉默，知道他总有一天会离开自己。但是...

say:16:1320612014:1.text: So I prayed every night for my brother to stay with me for one more day, and at dawn the next day, I would pray again and rejoice that the gods had answered my prayers.
say:16:1320612014:1.source_cn: 所以我祈求，祈求哥哥能多我陪伴一天。到了第二天的黎明，...

say:17:1320612015:1.text: I didn't know that my brother had to pay such a terrible price for my selfish desires and that he was trapped in such soul-wrenching pain all these years...
say:17:1320612015:1.source_cn: 我不知道为了满足自私的愿望，哥哥要付出这么大代价……不...

say:18:1320612016:1.text: So, I am grateful and implore you to help me atone for the sins I've committed.
say:18:1320612016:1.source_cn: 所以我感激，并且恳求你们……求你们帮我赎清这么多年的罪孽。

say:19:1320612017:1.text: Please help my brother find peace...
say:19:1320612017:1.source_cn: 请帮哥哥他……获得安息吧。

choice_prompt:20:1320612017.text: Please help my brother find peace...
choice_prompt:20:1320612017.source_cn: 请帮哥哥他……获得安息吧。

say:21:1320612019:1.text: To bring peace to Callan's soul, we must discover a way to break the soul-binding enchantment placed on his mechanical form and set him free.
say:21:1320612019:1.source_cn: 想让铐兰的灵魂重获平静，需要想办法解开施加在机械躯体上...

say:22:1320612020:1.text: If we do that, you two will never speak again.
say:22:1320612020:1.source_cn: 那样做的话，他就再也不会回应你了。

say:23:1320612021:1.text: I'm prepared for that, my lord.
say:23:1320612021:1.source_cn: 子爵先生……我已经做好心理准备了。

say:24:1320612022:1.source_cn: 好吧，如果这是你的愿望。

say:25:1320612023:0.text: While my knowledge of soul-binding magic is limited, I believe if we find his real body and restore his soul to its rightful place, it will bring Callan much relief.
say:25:1320612023:0.source_cn: 缚灵魔法我所知不多，但如果能找到真正的遗体，让他的残魂...

say:26:1320612024:0.text: Of course, even if we managed to do this, Callan's soul has endured such tremendous damage that his remaining life force would fade quickly, but he would at least find peace at last.
say:26:1320612024:0.source_cn: 当然，即便这么做了，铐兰的灵魂已经破碎，残存的意识也会...

say:30:1320612028:1.text: I believe my brother's body is in <style="highlight">Whiteridge Temple</style>.
say:30:1320612028:1.source_cn: 我想……哥哥的遗体可能在<style=highligh...

say:31:1320612029:1.text: Why is he in the temple?

say:32:1320612030:1.text: Well, a lot happened between the time of my end and when I resurrected.
say:32:1320612030:1.source_cn: 从我失去意识到再次复生中间，发生了许多事情。

say:33:1320612031:0.text: Many people died during the war against the Hypofiends. Sometimes, only pieces of bodies were recovered. Upon my resurrection, I saw acolytes doing their best to collect them all. They were wrapped in linen and put into the church cellar.
say:33:1320612031:0.source_cn: 对抗魔物的战争爆发，许多人死了，连尸骨都残缺不全。修士...

say:34:1320612032:1.text: Thanks to our family's strong ties with Whiteridge Temple, the remains of our kin were held apart from the others, providing future descendants the chance to retrieve them for a fitting burial.
say:34:1320612032:1.source_cn: 但因为家族长辈与白山大教堂一向交好，与我们家族有关的遗...

say:35:1320612033:1.text: When I awoke, a long time had passed... The acolytes I knew in the temple were gone, and no one knew who I was.
say:35:1320612033:1.source_cn: 我苏醒的时候，已经过了很久很久……之前侍奉艾雅的修女姐...

say:36:1320612034:1.text: I'm a Graveborn, and Graveborn are not allowed in Whiteridge Temple.
say:36:1320612034:1.source_cn: 我是……亡灵。而亡灵，不得踏入白山大教堂。

choice_prompt:37:1320612034.text: I'm a Graveborn, and Graveborn are not allowed in Whiteridge Temple.
choice_prompt:37:1320612034.source_cn: 我是……亡灵。而亡灵，不得踏入白山大教堂。

say:38:1320612035:0.text: Here, the separation between the realm of the living and that of the dead is starkly apparent.
say:38:1320612035:0.source_cn: 这就是生者和亡者的界限，泾渭分明。

say:40:1320612036:1.text: Recently, some acolytes were brainwashed by a Hypogean, so the temple should be a mess right now. This time, they may not pay attention to us.
say:40:1320612036:1.source_cn: 之前修士们被恶魔影响而改信，教堂内部现在应该非常混乱，...

say:41:1320612037:1.text: This is our best chance to get inside and find Callan!
say:41:1320612037:1.source_cn: 这是我们进入教堂，找到铐兰的最好机会！

say:42:1320612038:1.text: Come on, Miss Carolina, we'll help you find your brother so you two can truly reunite.
say:42:1320612038:1.source_cn: 走吧，卡列琳娜小姐，我们会一起帮你找到铐兰，让你们真正团聚。

say:43:1320612039:1.text: Thank you. I truly appreciate everything you're doing.
say:43:1320612039:1.source_cn: 谢谢……我非常、非常感谢你们。

say:44:1320612040:1.text: When we went into the temple last time, I saw a few caskets in the <style="highlight">antechamber</style>. Let's go there and take a look!

choice:37:0:1.text: So you weren't able to bury Callan.
choice:37:0:1.source_cn: 所以你一直没能安葬铐兰
choice:37:0:1.male: So you weren't able to bury Callan.
choice:37:0:1.female: So you weren't able to bury Callan.

choice:37:1:2.text: Callan is waiting at the temple.
choice:37:1:2.source_cn: 所以铐兰一直在教堂里等待
choice:37:1:2.male: Callan is waiting at the temple.
choice:37:1:2.female: Callan is waiting at the temple.

choice:37:2:3.text: No wonder you seem so sad sometimes.
choice:37:2:3.male: No wonder you seem so sad sometimes.
choice:37:2:3.female: No wonder you seem so sad sometimes.

choice:29:0:1.text: Do you know where he's buried?
choice:29:0:1.male: Do you know where he's buried?
choice:29:0:1.female: Do you know where he's buried?

say:46:1320612027:1.text: It doesn't matter. I've already made up my mind.
say:46:1320612027:1.male: It doesn't matter. I've already made up my mind.
say:46:1320612027:1.female: It doesn't matter. I've already made up my mind.

choice:29:1:2.text: It must be hard to see his body.
choice:29:1:2.source_cn: 要面对亲人的尸体，很难受吧
choice:29:1:2.male: It must be hard to see his body.
choice:29:1:2.female: It must be hard to see his body.

choice:29:2:3.text: After so long, can you still find it?
choice:29:2:3.source_cn: 过了这么久，还能找到吗？
choice:29:2:3.male: After so long, can you still find it?
choice:29:2:3.female: After so long, can you still find it?

choice:20:1:2.text: To have the dead die again...
choice:20:1:2.source_cn: 竟然真的要让亡灵再死一次……
choice:20:1:2.male: To have the dead die again...
choice:20:1:2.female: To have the dead die again...

say:47:1320612018:1.text: Thank you for your comforting words, kind sir. I'll do my best until I send my brother off.
say:47:1320612018:1.source_cn: 谢谢你的安慰，仁慈的<male>先生</male><f...
say:47:1320612018:1.male: Thank you for your comforting words, kind sir. I'll do my best until I send my brother off.
say:47:1320612018:1.female: Thank you for your comforting words, kind lady. I'll do my best until I send my brother off.
